name: session-guard
description: Keeps a session-notes file fresh. A Stop hook blocks a turn once (with a reason telling the model what to record) when the turn used tools and the notes file is more than 30 minutes stale, untouched since the session's first turn, or missing; PreCompact records compactions so a stale file is updated right after one, and bounces a manual /compact once while the file is stale. Includes the session-notes skill.
